Hi all — attaching the completed questionnaire draft and an audit-logging overview. High-level answers below; details are in the questionnaire cells and the PDF.

SOC 2 / Compliance:
- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type II assessment in 2026 and can provide the report under NDA. (If Acme needs the report, we can share via secure link once an NDA is in place.)
- GDPR / DPA: We support a standard DPA for hosted customers. Data residency options available via Dedicated/Private deployments.
- HIPAA / BAA: We will sign a BAA for enterprise accounts with private deployment or contractual terms; hosted customers require a review — we have a standard BAA process we can initiate.

Audit logging capabilities (summary):
- Admin activity logs: full admin actions (who, what, when, target resource). Retention configurable per account.
- API request/response logs: request metadata (timestamp, route, client id, response code, latency). By default we do NOT store full request/response payloads containing customer data unless specifically requested and contracted for — payload logging is configurable and must comply with data handling agreements.
- Exportability: Logs exportable in NDJSON or CSV; native push to S3/Google Cloud Storage supported. Exports can be scheduled or streamed to a customer-managed bucket.
- Immutability / tamper evidence: We provide append-only internal storage with cryptographic checksums for tamper detection and an export workflow that supports WORM-style retention when exporting to customer S3 (customer bucket configured for Object Lock WORM). For on-prem/private deployments we can enable additional immutability controls per contract.
- Retention & retention policy: Retention windows configurable; typical options 30/90/365 days. Longer retention archived to customer S3.

Attachments included: redwood-audit-logging-overview.pdf (short product matrix) and vendor-security-questionnaire_ACME.xlsx (draft answers).

Next steps we propose:
1) Marissa to send the filled questionnaire + overview to Acme (target: May 7).
2) Technical deep-dive (45 min) with Neha to walk through export config and immutability flows — propose Tue May 10 or Wed May 11.
3) If Acme needs the SOC2 report, we’ll share under NDA — Marissa to coordinate.

If you want, I can also include a short log sample schema in JSON lines for their infra team.

Thanks,
